record.title: GGEN fanout current after CELL4 qualification
record.body: CELL4 had no CELL3-selected READY workstreams, so downstream manufacture remained 0 this wave. Exact consumer requalification exposed a shared canonical producer-schema defect across autofde-lab#88, autofde#33, and xaas#32; that defect was returned once to ggen-marketplace PR #321 with a permanent falsifier. Named compatible population remains ex4pm, gymact, autofde-lab, autofde, xaas, dspygen (U_named=6); ex4pm, gymact, and dspygen are default-lineage assimilated (M_named=3), so OpenFanoutObligations_named=3. Project memory also preserves inherited U_lower_bound>=17 without exact name binding, therefore global U and OpenFanoutObligations remain UNKNOWN except lower-bound implications. All six named compatible repositories have GGEN-caused downstream realization evidence (R_named=6), but current exact Q is not fully bound for ex4pm/gymact in the CELL3 record; dspygen is explicitly Q=true while the three new R80 consumers are Q=false. No exact global Q/F_Q or F_C total is fabricated. Named realization coverage R/U=100%; F_A=3; wave downstream commits=0; wave upstream commits=2; regenerations=0. Consequential DO=false.
